name: argentic
description: MCP servers and skills for Argentic: wake agents with durable memory, read what they remember, declare tools, set spend limits, and manage your account's API keys, usage and budget.

api_key.title: Argentic API key
api_key.description: Your Argentic API key (starts with aek_). Needed for the engine tools. If you don't have one yet, leave it empty: the argentic-platform tools can create one after you sign in.

model_key.title: Model provider key
model_key.description: Your own key for the model provider your agents run on (OpenRouter, OpenAI, and so on). Sent with each wake, never stored by Argentic. Needed only for tools that wake an agent.

base_url.title: Argentic API URL
base_url.description: Leave as is unless Argentic Labs gave you another address. No trailing slash.
